text:
release-bot: Initiating controlled drip for service=router from v5.2.0 -> v5.3.0. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Starting at 5% traffic. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with pauses and probes. Manual rollback only.
maya: Ack. I'll watch p95, errors, and traces. Plan is 5m probe between steps.
sam: Make sure session affinity is preserved. If we change cookie behavior, pin sessions to v5.2 for long-lived connections.
kevin: Proposed command: routerctl shift --svc router --from v5.2.0 --to v5.3.0 --steps 5,25,50,100 --pause 300s --preserve-affinity true
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: step 1 applied -> 5% routed to v5.3.0. Health checks passing. Telemetry snapshot: p95 120ms -> 130ms, error rate 0.10%.
maya: :eyes: p95 bumped slightly, error rate still low. Continue?
tina: I'm tailing logs — seeing ~8 502s from v5.3.0 hitting /predict in the last 2m. Stack shows upstream connect reset. Can we hold before next step?
kevin: Hold at 5% until we confirm. Any config diffs between v5.2 and v5.3 for downstream timeouts? Also suggest pin v5.3.0 to ai-slot=gradual to avoid accidental full traffic.
release-bot: release-bot: Rollback policy reminder: manual rollback only. Rollback command: routerctl rollback --svc router --to v5.2.0
sam: Quick check — feature flag "new-enc" was enabled in v5.3.0. That could explain decode errors. Recommend disabling for canary.
maya: Disabling flag now in the canary scope.
infra-bot: infra-bot: featureflagcli set router.new_enc false --env prod --scope canary -> SUCCESS
tina: After disabling, 502s dropped to 1 in the last 5m. Error rate down to 0.02%. p95 back near baseline. Looks good.
kevin: Good catch. Proceed to 25% in ~2 minutes but do not change cookie-affinity. Add a 10-minute watch after 50% before 100%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: advancing to 25% -> applied. Health good. Metrics: CPU +7% on new pods, latency stable.
maya: Reminder: update release notes + changelog with the flag change and session cookie note. Katie will publish release note once 100% complete.
sam: Note for teams: clients relying on kv-cache should expect a rewarm. We'll run a prober to warm caches on v5.3 nodes.
kevin: Run warming: ./tools/traffic-prober --target router.v5.3.0 --warm 60s --pattern cache-hit-heavy
tina: Scheduling warmers now. Also note: session-id cookie name changed in 5.3.0 but kept backward compatibility; still watching edge cases.
maya: If anything crosses thresholds, rollback immediately. Agreed? :+1:
kevin: Agreed. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 300ms. I'll add those alerts.
release-bot: release-bot: Alerting rules configured for the thresholds above and will notify #incidents and this channel.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: progressed to 50% after 10m pause. Metrics: error 0.03%, p95 140ms. Holding for 10m as requested.
maya: Holding. Traces look clean, no new hotspots. If stable after hold, schedule 100% at +30m pending docs.
sam: Ops note: per-zone route table changes applied. Rollback path is a single command; I will be standing by to run it if needed.
tina: Thanks — recording operational decisions: keep version pin for 1h after 100% for long-session flows and warm cache policy documented. Release notes draft in docs/releases/4951234567-notes.md
maya: Closing notes: we'll mark done once 100% stable and docs published. Great job everyone. :white_check_mark:
